text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, January 16, 2018 Posted by admin on January 16th, 2018 
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL), Boeing (BA), Caterpillar (CAT), Cisco (CSCO), Chevron (CVX), Home Depot (HD), Johnson & Johnson (JNJ), JPMorgan (JPM), 3M (MMM), Microsoft (MSFT), United Technologies (UTX) and Exxon Mobil (XOM). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +173 points. 
Friday the Dow was up +228.46 (+0.89%) at 25,803.19. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +4.39%. 
There were 24 Dow stocks up Friday. 
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Boeing (BA) +2.47% and Cisco (CSCO) +1.92%. 
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by General Electric (GE) -1.37% and IBM (IBM) -0.65%. 
General Electric (GE) will take a $6.2 billion charge for the fourth quarter as the manufacturing behemoth grapples with lingering problems in a legacy insurance business. 
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended higher. 
The national average price of gasoline is up one-tenth of a cent at $2.530 per gallon.
